---
title: "About this textbook"
---

## Who it is for

This textbook is written for students who are new to econometrics (an introductory first course). Readers need only basic statistics: means, variances, and summation notation $\sum$.

## Using the figures

Each page contains interactive figures in framed boxes: move the sliders, press the buttons, or click points on a chart. The figures work on computers and phones and follow light or dark mode.

## Print and PDF versions

Every interactive figure has a static counterpart that appears when the page is printed or saved as PDF, with a **key message** and a link (plus a QR code once the site is published) back to the interactive version. Use the **Show print view (PDF)** button to preview it, then your browser's print menu and *Save as PDF* (preferably in light mode).

## Notation and terms

| Notation | Meaning | Indonesian term |
|---|---|---|
| $Y$, $X$ | dependent and independent variable | variabel dependen, independen |
| $\beta_1$, $\beta_2$ | population intercept and slope | intersep, kemiringan |
| $\hat\beta_1$, $\hat\beta_2$ | sample estimates | taksiran |
| $u_i$ | error term, disturbance | galat |
| $\hat u_i$ | residual | residual |
| $E(Y \mid X)$ | conditional mean | rata-rata bersyarat |
| SSR | sum of squared residuals | jumlah kuadrat residual |

Decimals use a point (0.957). Notation follows @gujarati2009. Monetary values are in millions of Indonesian rupiah (IDR).
